# OSINT4ALL
> Jurisdiction-aware, evidence-first, machine-readable atlas of OSINT and intelligence resources.

## Purpose
OSINT4ALL maps resources by jurisdiction, intelligence discipline, target-input class, use case, implementation type, validation state and evidence workflow. It is a catalogue and methodology project, not an autonomous target-collection agent.

## Canonical machine-readable files
- data/resources.json — canonical resource catalogue
- data/taxonomies.json — controlled vocabularies
- data/upstreams.json — upstream provenance and curation decisions
- data/emerging.json — emerging-project watchlist
- data/history.json — catalogue evolution
- data/upstream-snapshots.json — change-intelligence baselines
- schema/resource.schema.json — resource schema
- schema/playbook.schema.json — source-selection playbook schema
- schema/evidence-bundle.schema.json — evidence/provenance graph bundle schema

## Safe router
Use scripts/osint4all_router.py to filter catalogue metadata by input type, jurisdiction, discipline, domain, status, execution class or playbook. The router makes no network requests and does not accept target values.

## Evidence rules
- AI output is not evidence.
- Facts require source/capture provenance.
- Machine similarity may create only unresolved entity-resolution candidates.
- Human review is required for positive/negative same_as decisions.
- Resource validation, observation confidence, resolution similarity and analytical confidence are separate scales.

## Documentation

- ETHICS.md — ethical and lawful use
- VALIDATION.md — catalogue validation

## Languages
English is the canonical machine-facing language. Portuguese (pt-BR) is a first-class human-facing language, especially for Brazil jurisdiction packs.
